name: embroider-design
description: End-to-end embroidery CAD software: design shapes, text and image-based auto-digitized embroidery patterns, and export machine-ready files (Brother PES, DST, EXP, JEF, VP3, XXX).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @embroider-design/engine && npm run build -w @embroider-design/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @embroider-design/engine && npm run typecheck -w @embroider-design/app
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @embroider-design/engine && npm run dev -w @embroider-design/app
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @embroider-design/app
